title: The Morning Digest: October 27, 2026
dek: Monday's settles were Brent Dec26 $115.81 (down $0.91) and WTI Dec26 $101.76 (down $1.51), after Brent round tripped through $117 intraday; the deep late prints near $114.20 were intraday, not settles. Asia traded Brent at $114.81 and WTI at $100.88 at 0418 GMT on Tuesday (Reuters), a second down day on diplomacy headlines from Tehran talks that produced an agreement to keep talking and nothing else. UKMTO disclosed Monday that a tanker transiting outbound through Hormuz was struck by an unknown projectile on Oct 23 and disabled, crew safe, the first verified disablement of this claim cycle. December WCS widened a second day to -$29.25 (ICE TMW settle, Oct 26) on only 50 lots, while the January export spread narrowed to +$7.80 on traded volume both sides. The diesel crack printed $98.16, below $100 for a third print. A correction to Monday's edition: the Saudi energy minister's venue this week was Singapore, not Bahrain.
